target_customer: B2B revenue and sales teams managing pipeline in a CRM
problem: Sales reps lose deals to repetitive back office work and scattered CRM data; FirstQuadrant used AI to automate follow up, enrichment and outreach.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for AI sales tooling

founders.name: Carlo Badini
previous_startups: Swiss design agency founded at 20, bootstrapped to 40+ employees
founders.background_notes: YC page and launch post: EY Entrepreneur of the Year, Forbes 30 Under 30.

founders.name: Anand Chowdhary
founders.background_notes: YC page; launch post names Oswald Labs and Melangebox.

exit.reason: Company says it completed a confidential agreement with a leading AI technology company that valued components of its platform and data infrastructure, and sunset the platform

technical_complexity.rationale: CRM integrations and data enrichment are standard; the AI automation layer was moderately hard for a two person team in 2021.

defensibility.rationale: CRM integration gives mild lock in, but Outreach, Salesloft and later AI sales agent startups offered overlapping features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The platform was sunset in October 2025 after a confidential agreement with an unnamed AI company; the company also acquired Flike in June 2024.

market_need_then: Sales teams depended on CRMs and sales engagement tools in 2021; the launch post argues reps struggle with behind the scenes tasks, with no spend data found.

branding.community_and_virality: Company site cites a number one Product of the Day ranking on Product Hunt.

brand_strength.rationale: A Product Hunt win but no other brand evidence; the name collides with an unrelated asset manager First Quadrant.

outcome_analysis: FirstQuadrant raised a reported 2.5M pre-seed in 2021, bought Flike in June 2024, and sunset the platform in October 2025 after a confidential agreement with an unnamed AI company that valued parts of the platform and data. The financial terms and the cause of the sunset are not public, so no failure factor is assigned.
notes: The sunset page says FirstQuadrant was founded in 2022 while YC says 2020; 2020 kept. The round rests on a single database (CB Insights), which says total raised is about 3M over 3 rounds, so about 0.5M in two rounds is unrecorded. Exit type set to unknown because the deal is confidential and may be an asset sale or acquihire; the YC page says Inactive. No dated competitor source from the batch period was found (launch posts name none), so the list is empty.
